## Scope

The quality audit covered 172 second reads taken during the quarter. The review considered the consistency of grading across the audited cases and examined whether the recorded assessments were in agreement. The audit focused on the completed second reads available for review and did not extend beyond that set of records.

## Result

Overall agreement was 75.6 per cent. This result provides the overall measure for the audit and should be considered alongside the individual findings for each grader. Per-grader results are recorded in the attached spreadsheet. Those results will be discussed privately with each grader to support review of the findings and any required follow-up. The spreadsheet provides the detailed breakdown underlying the overall result and should be retained with the audit documentation.
